noPermission.title: You may not report operations here
noPermission.body: Reporting bundles needs the scan role at this station. Ask your team leader.

scan.label: Scan the bundle ticket
scan.hint: Scan the ticket of the bundle you work on.
scan.empty: Scan the ticket: the bundle opens with all its pieces good, so Finish is one tap.

wrongType.title: {type} label: scan a bundle ticket.
wrongType.body: Only a bundle's ticket is reported here.

notOnTablet.body: This bundle is not on this tablet and there is no network. Report it when the network is back, or ask your team leader.

refusal.fallback: This bundle cannot be reported here.

REPLACED.fix: Use the new ticket {code}; the old one takes no scan any more.

VOIDED.fix: No scan takes it any more. Ask your team leader.

WORK_ORDER_NOT_OPEN.fix: Its bundles are reported only while it is released or in progress. Ask your team leader.

NO_OPERATION_HERE.message: Bundle {code} has nothing left to do at this station.
NO_OPERATION_HERE.fix: Take it to its next operation, or ask your team leader.

NO_STATION.message: This tablet has no station: operations are reported at a station.
NO_STATION.fix: Ask the office to give this tablet its station.

PREVIOUS_NOT_REPORTED.message: The operation before this one is not reported yet.
PREVIOUS_NOT_REPORTED.fix: It may still be on another tablet. Report it first, or ask your team leader.

FLOOR_NOT_READY.message: Reports are held at this site until its floor is ready.

UNKNOWN_BUNDLE.message: This is not a bundle ticket of this site.
UNKNOWN_BUNDLE.fix: Scan the bundle's ticket again, or ask your team leader.

OTHER_KIND.message: This operation is other work than this station does.
OTHER_KIND.fix: Take the bundle to the right station, or ask your team leader.

WRONG_BUNDLE.message: This bundle is for another line.
WRONG_BUNDLE.fix: Take it to its line, or ask your team leader.

MORE_THAN_PASSED.message: More pieces than the operation before passed.
MORE_THAN_PASSED.fix: Count them again, or ask your team leader.

MORE_THAN_BUNDLE.message: More pieces than this bundle holds.
MORE_THAN_BUNDLE.fix: Count them again: no override lifts this.

LESS_THAN_TAKEN.message: Fewer good pieces than the next operation already took.
LESS_THAN_TAKEN.fix: Count them again, or ask your team leader.

ON_HOLD.message: This bundle or its work order is on hold.
ON_HOLD.fix: Keep it aside and ask your team leader.

MACHINE_UNSAFE.message: The machine at this station is marked do not use.
MACHINE_UNSAFE.fix: Work at another station, or ask your team leader.

COMPONENTS_MISSING.message: A component's lot is not scanned yet.
COMPONENTS_MISSING.fix: Scan the lot of the component you used.

WRONG_COMPONENT.message: This lot is not a material of this garment.
WRONG_COMPONENT.fix: Take it away and scan the lot of the component in your hand.

UNKNOWN_LOT.message: This is not a lot of this site.
UNKNOWN_LOT.fix: Scan the lot's label again, or ask your team leader.

LOT_NOT_RELEASED.message: This lot is not released: only a released lot goes into a garment.
LOT_NOT_RELEASED.fix: Use a released lot, or ask quality to release this one.

COMPONENT_COUNT.message: The lots do not cover every garment that goes on.
COMPONENT_COUNT.fix: Say how many garments each lot covers.

CHECKLIST_OPEN.message: A required step of this operation is not ticked.

CHECKLIST_REPORTED.message: This bundle is reported here already: its steps are closed.
CHECKLIST_REPORTED.fix: Ask a correction if something is wrong.

CHECKLIST_STEP_UNKNOWN.message: This step is no longer part of the operation.

ALREADY_REPORTED.message: This bundle is already reported here.
ALREADY_REPORTED.fix: Take it to its next operation.

OTHER_RUNNING.message: Another bundle is running on your name.
OTHER_RUNNING.fix: Pause it, hand it back or finish it first.

OPEN_BY_OTHER.message: Another person is working on this bundle.
OPEN_BY_OTHER.fix: Your team leader can see who.

ALREADY_PAUSED.fix: Resume it when you are back.

NOT_STARTED.fix: Start it, or just Finish it.

NO_PIECES.message: Say how many pieces are done.

PIECES_TOO_MANY.message: That is as many as the bundle holds.

NOT_QUALIFIED.message: This operation is not on your skills yet.
NOT_QUALIFIED.fix: A team leader may override it with their PIN and a reason.

NOT_AUTHORISED.message: You are not authorised for this operation.
NOT_AUTHORISED.fix: Ask your team leader: no override lifts this.

TEAM_NOT_IN_CREW.message: Someone on the team is no longer on this tablet.
TEAM_NOT_IN_CREW.fix: Check the crew, then try again.

TEAM_NOTICE.message: Someone on the team has not read the worker notice.
TEAM_NOTICE.fix: They read it first, on their own sign-in.

BUNDLE_RUNNING.fix: Pause or finish the bundle first.

otherFactory.title: This label is not from this factory
otherFactory.body: Scan a bundle ticket of this factory.

typo.title: The code was misread
typo.body: Scan the ticket again, slowly and straight.

own.title: You reported it at Op {seq} at {time}
own.undo: Undo it now if the counts are wrong: its window is still open.
own.ask: If the counts are wrong, ask a correction: the report stays until your team leader decides.

other.title: Already reported at Op {seq} at {time}{where}
other.body: It was reported by another person — your team leader can see who. One report per bundle per operation.

counts.title: Count the pieces
counts.tapHint: Tap a count to change it.
counts.stepGood: Good, one piece at a time

rule.held: More than the operation before passed ({count}): a team leader signs at Finish.
rule.told: More than the operation before passed ({count}): your team leader is told.

held.unknown: Nothing passed to this operation yet

work.component: Scan the lot of {code}: {covered} of {garments} covered
work.lotCount: Say how many garments lot {code} covers

leave.title: Leave this count?
leave.body: These counts are not finished. Keep counting, or leave them and open the new bundle.

correction.offline: The list of your reports needs the network. The report just made on this tablet can be corrected now.

empty.title: Nothing reported today
empty.body: Your reports of today show here, newest first.

correction.keeps: The report stays as it is until your team leader decides; then a correction replaces it.

sent.title: Sent to your team leader
sent.body: Waiting for your team leader. The report stays until it is decided.

timing.title: This bundle's time
timing.handBackBody: The time so far stays on the record; anyone may start it again.
timing.piecesHint: Another person can then carry on with the rest.
timing.noPieces: Nothing to say so far: finish the bundle.
timing.other: Another person is working on it. Your team leader can see who.
timing.qualification: This operation is not on your skills yet: your team leader is told.

pause.needsWords: Say why in a few words

guard.title: Stop: this does not count yet
guard.lift: A team leader may override it here with their PIN and a reason.
guard.noLift: No override lifts this. Do what it says, or ask your team leader.
guard.liftReport: Go back to change the counts, or a team leader overrides it here with their PIN and a reason.

override.title: Team leader override
override.words: Say why in a few words
override.signsBadge: Badge read. Sign with your PIN.
override.offline: The override needs the network: the PIN is checked by the office.

problem.wrong: Wrong badge or PIN. Try again, or ask another team leader.
problem.self: A team leader never overrides their own scan. Ask another team leader.
problem.notLead: This person may not override floor checks. Ask a team leader of this site.
problem.note: With "Other" say why in a few words.
problem.locked: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, or ask another team leader.
problem.unavailable: The office is not answering. Try again.

components.title: Scan what you used
components.hint: Scan the label of the lot in your hand.
components.most: At most {count}: the last lot takes the rest
components.unchecked: Saved on this tablet: the office checks the lot when the report arrives.

stack.heldCounts: Finish or leave this count first
stack.hint: Up to {count} bundles, then Finish once.
stack.empty: Scan the bundles you have finished.
stack.offline: Saved on this tablet: each bundle is sent as its own report.
stack.partly_one: {count} bundle finished; {refused} stays here with its reason.
stack.partly_other: {count} bundles finished; {refused} stay here with their reason.
stack.heldShade: Shades do not match: take one off
stack.heldRefused: Take the refused bundles off, or report them alone
stack.failed: The office is not answering. Nothing was lost: try again.
stack.signed: Signed by the team leader: that bundle counts.
stack.notFound: {code} is not a bundle ticket of this site.
stack.notOnTablet: {code} is not on this tablet: report it when the network is back.
stack.pick: {code} has two operations here: report it alone.
stack.refused: {code} cannot be reported here: scan it alone to see why.
stack.full: The stack is full: finish these first.
stack.shade: These parts are from different shade lots: they may not be joined. Take one off and ask your team leader.
stack.leaveBody: These bundles are not reported yet: they stay as they are.
stack.noneFinished_one: Nothing finished: {count} bundle stays here with its reason.
stack.noneFinished_other: Nothing finished: {count} bundles stay here with their reason.

indirect.open: No bundle: what are you doing?
indirect.question: No bundle: what are you doing?

offline.title: The tiles are not on this tablet
offline.body: They come back with the network.

empty.title: No tiles at this site
empty.body: Ask your team leader to add them in Floor rules.

indirect.queues: Saved on this tablet, sent when the network is back.
indirect.scanReturns: Scanning a bundle returns to standard.

note.title: Photo or comment
note.question: What differs from the plan?
note.reminder: Keep faces out of the picture.
note.offline: A photo or clip needs the network; a comment is saved on this tablet.
note.full: At most {count} files on one note.
note.failed: The picture did not go up. Take it again.
note.detail: With "Other" say what differs in a few words, or add a photo.

held.detail: Say what differs, or add a photo
held.busy: The picture is still going up

clip.title: Record a 15-second clip
clip.failed: This tablet cannot record a clip. Take a photo instead.

done.handBack: {code} handed back: the time is kept
done.note: {code}: note posted to the work order
